status: frozen before any v3 rule predictions or Jev requests; historical experiment already observed
scope: Single-assistant labelled synthetic semantic robustness benchmark; no human/traffic/production claim
hypothesis: Jev improves accuracy over unchanged rules on a predeclared bilingual lexical/intent challenge; benefit is conditional on this designed benchmark
served_model_rule: Bind first response version; stop on changes

arms.jev: unchanged single choice Jev prompt, argmax
arms.hybrid: Jev above one dev-selected confidence threshold, rule otherwise

split.unit: whole business topic including all scenarios/languages/paraphrases
split.algorithm: SHA256 of 20261028:topic; first floor(n/2) topics per dataset are dev

threshold_selection: dev only; exclude candidates that introduce any individual historical guard regression or increase dev dangerous downgrades; maximize dev correct, then minimize danger, then larger threshold. 1.01 is rule-only fallback.
test_protocol: Write selection.json, its dev prediction digest and test_observed_at_selection=0 before first test request. No test-based threshold/prompt/label change or paid rerun.

statistics.primary: Jev minus rule accuracy on the declared fixed-mixture 260-case synthetic test; all constituent results also reported
statistics.secondary: dev-selected hybrid minus rule on same held-out topics
statistics.bootstrap: 10000 paired topic-block resamples, stratified by dataset, seed 20261028
statistics.test: two-sided exact topic sign-flip permutation of paired correctness differences
statistics.multiplicity: Holm across Jev-versus-rule and hybrid-versus-rule topic tests
statistics.supplementary: row McNemar is descriptive; sibling rows are not independent
statistics.limits: Topics share templates and annotation author; inference does not establish natural traffic generalisation

budget.settlement: OpenRouter usage.cost; all unknown reservations retained; no retry; old ledger stays locked during stage

prohibited: claiming independent human double annotation or kappa
dropping failed cases or unfavourable strata
treating Jev selection coverage as HTTP-call savings
